topPRs.title: feat: OAuth auth (Claude Max) + TEXT_REASONING handlers
topPRs.author: standujar
topPRs.body:
## Summary - **OAuth authentication**: Route LLM calls through Claude Max subscription instead of API keys. Reads credentials from macOS Keychain or `~/.claude/.credentials.json` (Linux/Windows), with `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` env var fallback. Activated via `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_MODE=claude-max`. - **TEXT_REASONING_SMALL / TEXT_REASONING_LARGE handlers**: New model handlers with extended thinking support, using the existing `generateTextWithModel` infrastructure. - **Rate limit logging**: Logs 5h/7d quota utilization on every OAuth response, warns on 429 with reset time. ## Usage ```bash # API key (unchanged) ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-... bun test # Claude Max OAuth (auto-detect from OS credential store) ANTHROPIC_AUTH_MODE=claude-max bun test # Claude Max OAuth (explicit token, CI) ANTHROPIC_AUTH_MODE=claude-max CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=sk-ant-oat01-... bun test ``` ## Test plan - [x] Credential store reads token from macOS Keychain - [x] OAuth Bearer auth accepted by Anthropic API (Haiku tested successfully) - [x] Rate limit headers parsed and logged - [x] 401 retry with token re-read works - [ ] Linux/Windows credential file path (`~/.claude/.credentials.json`) - [ ] Full E2E test suite via ElizaOS runtime ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added support for Claude reasoning models (small and large variants) * Added OAuth authentication support as an alternative to API key authentication * Extended configuration options for authentication mode and model selection * **Chores** * Version bump to 2.0.0-alpha.15

Greptile Summary

This PR adds OAuth authentication for Claude Max subscriptions (reading credentials from macOS Keychain or `~/.claude/.credentials.json`) and two new `TEXT_REASONING_SMALL/LARGE` model handlers that route to configurable reasoning models. The credential-store and config plumbing are clean, but there is one functional concern in the OAuth fetch layer worth addressing before merge. - **P1 (`anthropic.ts` line 27):** `headers.set("anthropic-beta", "oauth-2025-04-20")` silently replaces any beta flag the `@ai-sdk/anthropic` SDK injects for extended thinking. Combined with the new reasoning handlers, this means OAuth + thinking will silently degrade to standard generation. Should merge the value instead of overwriting.

Confidence Score: 4/5

Safe to merge after fixing the anthropic-beta header overwrite; all other findings are P2 style/usability items One P1 issue exists: the OAuth fetch wrapper replaces the anthropic-beta header instead of merging it, which will break extended thinking when OAuth mode is active — exactly the combination the new reasoning handlers are designed for. The fix is a single-line change. All remaining findings (noisy logging, undrained response body, log message copy) are P2 and don't block correctness. typescript/providers/anthropic.ts — the beta-header merge fix is needed here

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | typescript/providers/anthropic.ts | Adds OAuth fetch wrapper and 401 retry; P1 issue: headers.set("anthropic-beta", ...) overwrites SDK-injected beta flags needed for extended thinking; P2: quota logs every response; P2: response body not drained before retry | | typescript/utils/credential-store.ts | New file implementing OAuth token retrieval from macOS Keychain, credentials file, and env vars; caching logic is correct; expiresAt: Infinity for env tokens is safe given guarded callers | | typescript/models/text.ts | Adds handleReasoningSmall and handleReasoningLarge handlers; thinking only activates when ANTHROPIC_COT_BUDGET* is set — this dependency is not documented or enforced in the handlers themselves | | typescript/init.ts | Extends initialization to validate OAuth token on startup; P2: log message names ANTHROPIC_OAUTH_TOKEN when CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is the primary env var | | typescript/utils/config.ts | Adds getAuthMode, getReasoningSmallModel, getReasoningLargeModel helpers and skips API key validation when OAuth mode is active; clean implementation | | typescript/index.ts | Registers the two new reasoning model type handlers and adds config entries for auth mode and reasoning models; purely additive |

Sequence Diagram

```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant R as ElizaOS Runtime participant P as anthropic.ts (createOAuthFetch) participant CS as credential-store.ts participant API as Anthropic API R->>P: generateText / streamText P->>CS: getClaudeOAuthToken() alt env var set (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN) CS-->>P: { accessToken, expiresAt: Infinity } else cached token still valid CS-->>P: cachedToken else read from store CS->>CS: readFromMacKeychain() / readCredentialsFile() CS-->>P: { accessToken, expiresAt } end P->>P: delete x-api-key header P->>P: set Authorization: Bearer token P->>P: set anthropic-beta: oauth-2025-04-20 ⚠️ overwrites SDK betas P->>API: HTTP request API-->>P: response alt status 200 P->>P: log quota utilization (5h/7d) P-->>R: response else status 429 P->>P: log rate-limit + reset time P-->>R: 429 response else status 401 P->>CS: clearTokenCache() P->>CS: getClaudeOAuthToken() fresh read CS-->>P: freshToken P->>API: retry with fresh token API-->>P: response P-->>R: response end ```

Comments Outside Diff (1)

 1. `typescript/models/text.ts`, line 665-688 ([link](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/blob/c75493a5c00b66acd9d1898a35ffbea3b803dd53/typescript/models/text.ts#L665-L688)) **Reasoning handlers require an additional env var to actually reason** `handleReasoningSmall` and `handleReasoningLarge` delegate to `generateTextWithModel`, which only enables extended thinking when `getCoTBudget(runtime, modelSize) > 0` — i.e., when `ANTHROPIC_COT_BUDGET_SMALL/LARGE` or `ANTHROPIC_COT_BUDGET` is configured. Without that env var, both handlers call the reasoning model with standard (non-thinking) text generation, silently producing ordinary results. Consider either (a) setting a sensible non-zero default `cotBudget` inside these handlers, or (b) making the dependency explicit in a code comment and the plugin README so callers know to set the budget.

topPRs.title: feat: add CLI auth mode (claude -p subprocess)
topPRs.author: standujar
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Adds a third auth mode `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_MODE=claude-cli` that routes all model calls through `claude -p` (Claude Code CLI headless mode). Unlike direct OAuth token extraction (which Anthropic actively blocks for third-party tools), the CLI path uses Claude Code's own authenticated session.

## How it works

When `claude-cli` mode is active, `generateTextWithModel()` bypasses the AI SDK entirely and spawns `claude -p` for each call. The CLI handles auth via the user's existing Claude Code session.

- **Non-streaming:** `claude -p --model <model> --output-format json` — parses `result` + `modelUsage` from JSON output
- **Streaming:** `claude -p --model <model> --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-partial-messages` — yields `text_delta` events in real-time, returns a full `TextStreamResult` (textStream, text, usage, finishReason)

## Three auth modes

| Mode | Env var | Speed | Risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| Default | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-...` | Fast | None (pay-per-token) |
| `claude-cli` | `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_MODE=claude-cli` | ~3s/call | Grey area |
| `oauth` | `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_MODE=oauth` | Fast | May be blocked |

## Benchmarks

| Test | Latency |
|---|---|
| Haiku sequential | ~3s |
| Sonnet sequential | ~3s |
| 5x Haiku parallel | ~4s total (0.8s/call avg) |
| Sonnet streaming | ~4s (5 chunks, real-time text_delta) |

## Files changed

- `typescript/utils/claude-cli.ts` (NEW) — `generateViaCli()` + `streamViaCli()` 
- `typescript/utils/config.ts` — `getAuthMode()` now returns `"cli" | "oauth" | "apikey"`
- `typescript/models/text.ts` — CLI path in `generateTextWithModel()` (streaming + non-streaming)
- `typescript/init.ts` — CLI mode validation (checks `claude` command exists)
- `typescript/package.json` — bump to `alpha.17`

## Test plan

- [x] Haiku via `claude -p` — works
- [x] Sonnet via `claude -p` — works (no rate limit block unlike OAuth)
- [x] Parallel calls — works, ~0.8s/call avg
- [x] Streaming via CLI — works, real text_delta chunks
- [x] Usage events emitted in both streaming and non-streaming
- [ ] Opus with extended thinking via CLI
- [ ] Integration with ElizaOS runtime

topPRs.title: fix(ci): align npm workflow and TS package with standalone publish
topPRs.author: odilitime
topPRs.body:
- Gate releases on typescript/package.json and run bun publish from typescript/ - Replace @elizaos/core workspace:* with published versions so bun install works in CI - Externalize jsonrepair (and match Node externals) in the browser Bun build Made-with: Cursor --- > [!NOTE] > **Medium Risk** > Release automation and build output behavior change (publish gating and browser bundling externals), which can affect what gets published and runtime dependency expectations. > > **Overview** > Updates the npm GitHub Action to gate releases on changes to `typescript/package.json` (and its version) and to run `bun publish` from the `typescript/` directory. > > Adjusts the TypeScript package to be installable outside the monorepo by pinning `@elizaos/core` to a published alpha version (dev + peer), and tweaks the Bun browser build to externalize `jsonrepair` (and `undici`) to match Node externals and avoid flaky CI bundling. > > Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 659c51f7a8beb778c96a61efc6786cfe4397249f. Bugbot is set up for automated code reviews on this repo. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot). ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Chores** * Updated deployment workflow to target specific package location * Aligned build configuration for consistent external dependency handling * Updated core dependency version to prerelease alpha

Greptile Summary

This PR fixes three inter-related CI issues: the version-gate now correctly watches `typescript/package.json` (the artifact that is actually published), `bun publish` is run from the `typescript/` directory, and `@elizaos/core`'s `workspace:*` references are replaced with concrete version pins so `bun install` works in standalone CI environments. The browser Bun build is also updated to externalize `jsonrepair` and `undici`, matching the Node build's externals configuration.

Confidence Score: 5/5

Safe to merge — all three changes are targeted, correct, and address real CI breakage with no P0/P1 issues. The workflow logic is sound (scoped diff check, correct publish directory), the workspace:* removal unblocks CI installs, and the browser externals change is intentional and documented. Remaining notes are P2 style suggestions (pinned devDep range, browser consumer note) that do not block correctness. typescript/build.ts — browser consumers should be aware that jsonrepair is no longer bundled in the browser artifact.

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | .github/workflows/npm-deploy.yml | Version-gate logic correctly scoped to typescript/package.json; git diff check tightened with `-- typescript/package.json` path limiter and `grep -q .`; bun publish now runs from typescript/ directory; overall logic is sound. | | typescript/build.ts | Browser build externals now match Node externals; jsonrepair is no longer bundled in the browser artifact — consumers must supply it via their bundler, which is a behavioral change worth noting. | | typescript/package.json | workspace:* replaced with concrete versions; devDependency is an exact pin (no ^) while peerDependency uses ^2.0.0-alpha.162; both changes unblock standalone CI installs. |

Sequence Diagram

```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant GH as GitHub Push (1.x) participant VV as verify_version job participant PUB as publish job participant REL as create_release job participant NPM as npm registry GH->>VV: trigger on push to 1.x VV->>VV: read CURRENT_VERSION from typescript/package.json VV->>VV: git diff HEAD~1 HEAD -- typescript/package.json alt file changed VV->>VV: git show PREV_COMMIT:typescript/package.json | jq -e .version alt previous version exists and differs VV-->>PUB: should_publish=true else version unchanged VV-->>PUB: should_publish=false end else file not changed VV-->>PUB: should_publish=false end alt should_publish == true PUB->>PUB: git tag vX.Y.Z && git push PUB->>PUB: cd typescript && bun install PUB->>PUB: cd typescript && bun run build PUB->>NPM: cd typescript && bun publish PUB->>REL: trigger create_release REL->>GH: actions/create-release@v1 end ``` Reviews (1): Last reviewed commit: ["fix(ci): align npm workflow and TS packa..."](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/commit/659c51f7a8beb778c96a61efc6786cfe4397249f) | [Re-trigger Greptile](https://app.greptile.com/api/retrigger?id=28566467) > Greptile also left **2 inline comments** on this PR.

topPRs.title: fix: cast emitEvent payload for EventPayloadMap compat
topPRs.author: dutchiono
topPRs.body:
## Summary - `MODEL_USED` is no longer in `EventPayloadMap`'s known keys after the `@elizaos/core` alpha.115 update - Cast the payload to `EventPayload` to use the generic overload and fix `TS2769` ## Test plan - [ ] TypeScript type check passes (`bunx tsc --noEmit`) 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) ## Summary by CodeRabbit ## Release Notes * **Refactor** * Improved type safety for event emission handling.

Greptile Summary

This is a minimal, type-only fix to resolve `TS2769` caused by `EventType.MODEL_USED` being dropped from `EventPayloadMap`'s known keys in `@elizaos/core` alpha.115. Adding `as EventPayload` selects the generic `emitEvent` overload at compile time with no change to runtime behavior.

Confidence Score: 5/5

Safe to merge — type-only change with no runtime impact. Single-line type assertion fix targeting a known upstream breaking change in @elizaos/core alpha.115. No logic, data flow, or runtime behavior is altered; the only effect is resolving TS2769 at compile time. No files require special attention.

Vulnerabilities

 No security concerns identified.

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | typescript/utils/events.ts | Imports `EventPayload` and casts the `emitEvent` payload `as EventPayload` to resolve TS2769 after `MODEL_USED` was removed from `EventPayloadMap` in @elizaos/core alpha.115; no runtime logic changes. |

Sequence Diagram

```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Model as models/text.ts (image.ts, object.ts) participant Events as utils/events.ts participant Runtime as IAgentRuntime Model->>Events: emitModelUsageEvent(runtime, type, prompt, usage) Events->>Events: compute promptTokens, completionTokens, totalTokens Events->>Runtime: emitEvent(EventType.MODEL_USED, payload as EventPayload) Note over Events,Runtime: Cast to EventPayload selects generic overload (TS2769 fix) ``` Reviews (1): Last reviewed commit: ["fix: cast emitEvent payload for @elizaos..."](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/commit/6711acc78e013c3ae6f7d0afc1dde9d165e4363d) | [Re-trigger Greptile](https://app.greptile.com/api/retrigger?id=27879681)
